manual_reference_role.suffices_for: Independent short-time anchor of the unchanged physical RHS on the selected mesh, using the three common stored times.
does_not_certify: Two-cell transport, external heating or escape
Three genuine electronic or phonon grids
At least ten actual physical field/support sample times per cell

execution.estimated_scope: Hours are possible, especially for 2520 electronic states; exact aggregate time depends on the adopted temporal resolution. No long DOP853 trajectory is required by this proposal.

phase_1_temporal.reference_rule: A separate step-halved trajectory is explicitly permitted by the frozen criteria. Preserve the short independent DOP853 comparison; if the measured complete-run errors or refinement reductions fail, stop and diagnose before selecting any replacement resolution.
requirements: All measured observables and capacity-weighted populations meet the unchanged time gate
Three distinct resolutions and measured reduction at least 1.5 except roundoff
Every level and its reference meet ledger, instantaneous balance and physical-population gates
No clipping or correction of conserved energy

phase_2_dynamic_meshes.steps: Reuse the finest accepted candidate trajectory, provisionally 160, and hold the same time parameters for all refined meshes.
phase_2_dynamic_meshes.candidate_admission_rule: The first supplied grid is the proposed candidate; its own precision gate must PASS, as well as the finer comparisons and the measured convergence. A PASS for 1260 versus 2520 cannot admit 630.
phase_2_dynamic_meshes.scope_limit: Dynamic mesh evidence applies to this registered simultaneous two-cell problem. Do not state uniform convergence for arbitrary initial populations or all possible one-cell trajectories.

equilibrium.reference: Analytically stationary FD/BE distributions with self-consistent amplitudes and enabled transport/escape; includes Gamma=0.1 in the second cell.
equilibrium.caution: The zero-Gamma trajectory-field assessor cannot certify the finite-Gamma equilibrium spectrum; retain its separate causal reference or limit the field-assessor claim to the active zero-Gamma trajectories.

phase_3_stationarity_and_boundaries.boundary_time_rule: Use a step no larger than the accepted temporal step; measure invariants and physical populations. A new three-level sequence is needed if evidence indicates this boundary problem is not controlled by that step, not merely because the scenario name changed.
phase_3_stationarity_and_boundaries.isolated_channel_requirement: Frozen criteria additionally mention boundary trajectories in isolated applicable channels. Initial inward-RHS checks alone do not satisfy that wording. Use finite-duration isolated-collision tests from n=0 and mixed exact p=0/1 as needed. Full p=1 with a positive-temperature BGK inversion is outside that closure domain and must not be forced or repaired.

phase_4_postprocessing.field_checks: At least ten distinct actual physical times per cell, including endpoints and extrema; apply unchanged independent energy, force and derivative gates to accepted active trajectories.
phase_4_postprocessing.upper_support: Same minimum physical sampling, with independent absorption-to-unrepresented-states bounds and explicitly recorded disabled support.
phase_4_postprocessing.activity: At least one coupled trajectory resolves amplitude change >=0.02 and both e-ph and transport transfers >=1% of the preregistered available excitation scale.
phase_4_postprocessing.selected_static_reactions: Close the exact IR=.005 independent continuous reaction comparison and its reference-refinement budget; preserve earlier IR=.01 results separately.
phase_4_postprocessing.infrared: Use the already registered uncropped analytic-input omission comparison; no additional three long infrared trajectories are invented by this proposal.
phase_4_postprocessing.final_scope: Synthetic numerical one/two cells only. No absolute NbN rates, spatial condensate/circuit problem or full SNSPD transient is admitted.
